description: Single-instance, local-disk, bounded-concurrency embedded SQLite baseline.
compatibility_rules: Exactly one application instance may write the database.
Database, WAL and shared-memory files must remain on a local filesystem on the same host.
WAL permits concurrent readers but SQLite still has one writer; sustained write contention is an exit trigger.
Online backup must use the SQLite backup API or a documented equivalent consistent snapshot and must be restore-tested.

constraints.deployment: Single application instance only; horizontal scaling or shared database access is prohibited.
constraints.data_storage: Local host filesystem only; network filesystem, container ephemeral layer and multi-host access are prohibited.
constraints.concurrency: One writer; sustained lock contention, background write fan-out or more than one application instance requires PostgreSQL reassessment.
constraints.availability: No high-availability claim; host failure may require restore from backup.
constraints.backup: Scheduled online backup plus retained off-host checksum is mandatory.
constraints.restore_drill: Restore must be exercised at least semi-annually and before any schema or runtime major Change.
